subject: a Scaleway list the pack answers 400 against is vouched for by its vocabulary (#427)
why: A sanitised transcript replaces every value a pack does not vouch for, so a closed list the pack validates against and does not publish makes its own recording unreplayable -- the recorded create answers 400 and every read after it addresses an object that was never made. MEASURED on 2026-08-24: gatewayTypes was missing, one CreateGateway was refused on replay, and `feint corpus --check` reported 143 findings from that single cause, 126 of them 'GetGateway omits <field>' for a gateway that did not exist. The vocabulary's own comment stated the opposite in so many words -- 'a commercial type … this emulator does not validate a request against' -- which is this repository's most expensive defect wearing its usual clothes. #354 had already found the same thing four times in the Outscale pack.

mutations.expect: the gateway offers stop being vouched for, so a sanitiser mints a synthetic offer name and every recorded CreateGateway is refused on replay
mutations.label: the gateway offers stop being vouched for

mutations.expect: the zones stop being vouched for, so the zone in every recorded path becomes a synthetic string and the emulator answers 400 'unknown zone' to the whole corpus
mutations.label: the zones stop being vouched for

mutations.expect: the regions stop being vouched for, and every regional path of a recording is replayed at a region the pack refuses
mutations.label: the regions stop being vouched for

mutations.expect: an unknown gateway offer is accepted, so a plan naming an offer that does not exist passes here and fails in production -- and the join this spec protects could then be satisfied by deleting the validation instead of extending the vocabulary
mutations.label: an unknown gateway offer is accepted
